create_dino_pretraining_config: create a DINO pretraining config with mixed precision, activation checkpointing, GPU count, and epoch settings
create_dino_linear_eval_config: create a DINO linear evaluation config using a pretrained checkpoint path and GPU count for synthetic data
test_pretraining_and_evaluation: test DINO pretraining and linear evaluation on synthetic data with mixed precision over multiple GPUs
test_checkpointing: test that MLP and block activation checkpointing reduce memory usage without changing training losses
test_preemption_during_training: test training resumption after removing checkpoint files to verify preemption recovery behavior
